title: ALL ( Sales ) removes filters from the expanded table, so filters on the dimensions go too
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], ALL ( Sales ) ) ), 'Product'[Color] = "Red", 'Date'[Year] = 2024 )

source.quote: acts as REMOVEFILTERS on the expanded version of Sales, removing filters from the table and from all related dimension
source.supports: ALL ( Sales ) removes filters from Sales and from all related dimensions
in the page's last example ALL ( Sales ) gives the same value as ALL (), with filters on Product and Date outside

derivation: The outer filters are on Product and Date, both on the one side of relationships from Sales, so both are columns of the expanded Sales table. ALL ( Sales ) removes them: 540 (the filtered value is 300).
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
